description: OPT4048 is a high precision tristimulus XYZ color sensor from Texas Instruments. It has four channels that closely match the CIE 1931 color matching functions, so it reports CIE x and y chromaticity coordinates, illuminance in lux, and correlated color temperature in Kelvin. Conversion time, measurement range, and operating mode are all configurable. The sensor communicates via I2C.
